headline: China’s nine-agency opinion maps AI adoption across commerce, services and supply chains
summary: China’s Ministry of Commerce and eight other agencies published an 18-measure Opinion on technology-enabled commerce on October 19, 2026; the document itself is dated October 13. It calls for AI integration in product design and manufacturing, flexible and personalized production, selected health and cultural-tourism services, smart supply chains and logistics, and commercial agents. It also names inclusive-compute support for AI startups serving commerce, sector datasets and trusted data spaces, and scenario-based governance for commercial agents. This verifies a cross-agency policy direction and its stated instruments, not implementation, funding, adoption or productivity effects.
